analysis.title: UBS TECH DAILY CURT COMMENT: IFX & call today at 1:30UKT
key_insights: Crude traded at its lowest levels since August overnight (-1%, Brent $91.7, WTI $86.2) after President Trump said on Monday afternoon that "Iran, militarily, is effectively over". EStoxx started +90bps.
The US session saw a meaningful recovery across the AI value chain. Semis, Neoclouds and AI Winners finished +6-7%, and all indicators held best levels into the close.

Market breadth barely changed into the inflection in Tech (SPW +2.25%, SPX +2.35%). The desk reads this as more risk-on than pure relief and expects mild underperformance in Defensives over the coming sessions.
Asia followed the US lead. Chip-heavy benchmarks are off earlier highs but firmly higher: Topix and Taiex +2-3%, KOSPI +5%. SoftBank is up about 15% ahead of its earnings release, driving Japan.
TSM October sales were NT$586.9bn (+14.7% MoM, +59.7% YoY), tracking 34.2% of Q426 UBSe. Q4 QoQ sales growth is on track with UBSe of +15%.

Infineon Q4 was in line: revenue EUR4,706m (+19.4% y/y, +13% q/q) vs Street EUR4,709m. Gross margin was 45.1% vs Street 45.5%. EBIT was EUR1,119m (23.8% margin) vs Street EUR1,104m, a 1% beat. The stock was flattish.

Infineon FY27 guide: revenue about EUR20bn (+22% y/y) vs Street EUR19,944m, in line. Datacentre revenue is guided to 'close to E4bn', slightly light of a bogey of at least EUR4bn, with some at EUR4.5bn a few weeks ago.

Infineon FY27 gross margin guide of 'mid to high 40s%' (UBS reads about 48%) compares with Street 47.1%, which UBS calls better. FY27 EBIT margin of 'mid 20s%' (about 25%, EUR5bn) is in line with Street EUR5,028m (25.2%).

Infineon FY27 investment is planned at EUR3-3.5bn and FCF is EUR1.8bn vs Street EUR2.3bn, below the Street. Q1 revenue guide is EUR4.6bn (+26% y/y, -2% q/q) vs Street EUR4,612m, in line. Q1 EBIT is about EUR1,058m (margin 'around 23%') vs Street EUR1,072m, in line.

market_movers.rationale: Infineon (IFXGn.DE, no US listing) Q4 and FY27 guide were largely in line with Street. The gross margin guide was better, while datacentre revenue of close to EUR4bn was slightly light of the bogey and FCF of EUR1.8bn was below Street EUR2.3bn.

sector_views.rationale: Semis, Neoclouds and AI Winners rallied 6-7% in the US with breadth holding. The desk reads the move as more risk-on than pure relief and expects Defensives to underperform mildly.

Infineon FY27 guidance (company guide vs Street estimates): revenue about EUR20bn vs Street EUR19,944m. Gross margin 'mid to high 40s%' (UBS reads about 48%) vs Street 47.1%. EBIT margin 'mid 20s%' (about EUR5bn) vs Street EUR5,028m. FCF EUR1.8bn vs Street estimate EUR2.3bn. Investments EUR3-3.5bn. Datacentre revenue 'close to E4bn' vs a bogey of at least EUR4bn.
Infineon FQ1 guidance: revenue about EUR4.6bn vs Street estimate EUR4,612m. EBIT about EUR1,058m (margin 'around 23%') vs Street estimate EUR1,072m (23.2%). Both in line.
TSM October sales were NT$586.9bn (reported, +14.7% MoM, +59.7% YoY), tracking 34.2% of the UBS estimate for Q4 2026. UBS estimates Q4 QoQ sales growth of +15% and says the quarter is on track.
